title: Choose the visual world
question: Each direction makes Download resume the primary action and Contact me the immediate secondary action. Which world should shape Logan Farci's visual revamp?

options.label: Field Notes, continuous
options.lineage: the current site, edited with the information rhythm of an engineering field notebook
options.thesis: A single human-technical system: recognisably Logan's current site, reorganised with the confident editorial structure of practical engineering notes.
materials: thin rules and sparse evidence surfaces
options.viewport: Manrope-style hierarchy and the existing signal-blue/teal/copper system lead a spacious hero; Resume download and Contact are immediate, while a restrained field-note rail turns Experience, Writing, and Cloud systems into meaningful proof.
options.case: It keeps continuity for returning visitors and gains the Field Notes direction's authored clarity without a second visual language.
options.risk: It must keep annotation and numbering disciplined; too much turns a professional site into a notebook costume.

options.label: Signal Room
options.thesis: A precise professional briefing where proof, systems thinking, and a ready-to-use resume arrive as one confident signal.
options.viewport: A midnight signal field frames Logan's role and proof points; a copper Resume PDF control leads, with Contact me beside it and a restrained profile portrait as the human anchor.
options.risk: It can become dashboard theatre if the instrument grammar overwhelms the writing; articles and About need generous quiet space.

raised.raise: Warm internal illumination gives key proof and resume moments a human, welcoming glow rather than a cold interface sheen.
The long scroll has deliberate reveal points, so evidence is encountered in a clear sequence instead of a wall of equal cards.
Selected states communicate crisply and instantly, with no decorative animation standing between a visitor and the next action.

options.label: Field Notes
options.lineage: a well-used engineering notebook and technical monograph
options.thesis: Logan's site reads like an authored record of practical engineering judgment: warm, rigorous, and unmistakably personal without becoming casual.
options.viewport: A bright editorial title block introduces Logan and his specialty; Resume PDF is the clear primary action, Contact me is adjacent, and a compact margin note carries the personal signal.
options.risk: Editorial portfolio systems are familiar; it needs confident information density and exact annotation discipline to avoid looking like a generic personal journal.

options.label: Continuity, sharpened
options.lineage: the current site, edited into a more decisive professional system
options.thesis: Keep the familiar calm, technical voice while using the existing type and token system with much stronger editorial hierarchy and fewer repeated card surfaces.
options.viewport: The familiar Manrope greeting and Noto Sans body remain; Download resume leads a spacious asymmetric hero, Contact me stays beside it, and a thin proof rail replaces the equal-weight card grid.
options.case: This preserves continuity for returning visitors while directly addressing the critique's hierarchy, visual-language, and affordance findings.
options.risk: It has less surprise than the other worlds, so the spacing, editorial rhythm, and proof rail must carry real conviction.

options.label: Cathode Evidence
options.lineage: a calibrated cathode display and precision test bench
options.thesis: Experience is presented as evidence under illumination: selected work, current role, and resume availability strike forward while the rest remains visible in depth.
options.viewport: Logan's role is the single struck-forward line over a layered evidence field; Resume PDF glows as the primary control and Contact me stays plainly legible beside it.
options.case: It strongly signals engineering depth and a distinctive interaction system, but gives up some immediate warmth for first-time hiring readers.
options.risk: The dark, high-contrast world can read niche or severe if the human voice and article typography do not counterbalance it.

options.label: Versailles vistas
options.viewport: A long central axis turns the resume and contact invitation into a ceremonial first stop.
options.case: Declined: the formal spectacle competes with professional clarity and is not native to Logan's audience.
options.kept: Deliberate reveal sequencing for the long scroll.
options.risk: Over-formal for a direct technical portfolio.

options.label: Akari workshop
options.viewport: Warm paper volumes gather the introduction and actions around a calm profile image.
options.case: Declined: its warmth helps, but it cannot carry the full technical evidence system as directly as the lead world.
options.kept: Human warmth expressed as light, not as decorative texture.
options.risk: Too craft-led for the intended engineering authority.

options.label: Constructivist agit-train
options.viewport: A red action wedge carries the resume through a diagonal proof sequence.
options.case: Declined: its political, urgent rhetoric conflicts with Logan's close, enterprise-credible voice.
options.kept: None; action clarity is already stronger in the lead world.

options.label: Kinetic sand glyphs
options.viewport: A centered control dial directs the visitor to the resume and contact actions.
options.case: Declined: a speculative control metaphor would distract from factual professional proof.
options.kept: None; the product does not need a novel navigation mechanism.
options.risk: Too ornamental and culturally ungrounded for this portfolio.

options.label: Green-phosphor terminal
options.viewport: A typed system prompt invites a resume download and a direct contact command.
options.case: Declined: terminal nostalgia narrows the audience and makes readable articles harder to sustain.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished modern portfolio with a centered hero, blue accent, cards, and a clear resume CTA.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional two-column hero puts the resume CTA above a concise credential grid.
canonCard.risk: It is credible but intentionally easy to confuse with other developer portfolios.
